messages:
julia: Heads-up — after the midnight merge the canary showed a decode p95 spike (~2.4x) for short-chatty workloads. Noticed starting at 00:17 UTC.
ci-bot: PR merged: #3421 (kernel-scheduler-refactor) by @mike — commit 9f3a2b4
mike: ack, that refactor landed to make kernel routing cheaper. didn't see this in local perf tests though. grabbing perf traces.
sasha: I can repro on a repro runner. p95 jumps when sequence length < 48 and kv hit rate is high.
julia: here's a flamegraph snippet from the canary:
```
decode_top:
  42% kernel_selector::choose_fused
  28% attention::matmul_attn
  18% kv_cache::lookup
  12% copy_utils::memcpy
```
mike: that "choose_fused" % looks suspicious — scheduler might be misrouting fused kernels for short-seq cases.
ken: I pushed a quick CI job with extra logging to trace kernel decisions: https://ci.internal/3421-fuselog
deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused (auto-hold) — p95 > 1.5x threshold on route "chat-short".
julia: paging triage in #eng-runtime — can someone start a bisect? want to know which commit in the PR introduced behavior.
sasha: bisecting within the PR now — disabling the new heuristic makes p95 return to baseline locally.
mike: confirmed in my local bisect — the heuristic that bumps fused preference when batch_size>1 is overly eager, it doesn't account for kv cache reuse patterns.
ci-bot: Perf CI failed on job decode-p95 (canary) for commit 9f3a2b4 — regression +160% on chat-short.
ken: patch incoming to gate fused preference on estimated_kv_hit_rate > 0.2. opening draft PR.
julia: good, let's hold the rollout until we get a canary green. Also add a unit test for route heuristics (small-seq + high-kv).
sasha: also noticed memcpy spikes — might be extra copies introduced when switching kernels. adding a trace to record memcpy counts.
mike: thanks. if tests pass, can we revert the heuristic change in the scheduler and roll forward the fix? prefer revert to unblock customers.
ken: created PR #3426 revert heuristic + #3427 fix-with-guard. linking both in the deploy plan.
ci-bot: PR #3426 opened by ken — "revert: kernel scheduling heuristic". CI checks running.
julia: plan: merge revert to unfreeze rollout, then merge guarded fix behind feature flag. notify oncall.
sasha: running a quick canary with revert locally — p95 back to normal. will push to canary cluster in ~10m.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout resumed (after manual override) — route still held until new canary result.
mike: postmortem note: scheduler change didn't simulate kv-heavy microbenchmarks. adding synthetic kv-replay tests to CI.
julia: thanks everyone. I'll draft a short postmortem and tag the incident. add any logs/links here pls.
